steps.text: Open the active community's meter list and locate the meter whose current configuration you want to update.
steps.title: Meters list

steps.text: Click the meter row (EAN 123456789012345678) to open its detail page and reach the current meter-data view.
steps.title: Open the meter detail

steps.text: Tap the meter card (EAN 123456789012345678) to open its detail page and reach the current meter-data view.
steps.title: Open the meter detail

steps.text: The detail page shows the current configuration. The "Update data" action is only exposed when the meter is active — that is our entry point.
steps.title: Active meter

steps.text: Click "Update data" — a dialog opens, pre-populated with the meter's current configuration: description, powers, rate, client type and owner.
steps.title: Open the form

steps.text: Edit the description, the sampling power and the amperage. These updated figures feed straight into the sharing-operation allocation calculations.
steps.title: Adjust the energy values

steps.text: Edit the description, the sampling power and the amperage. These updated figures feed straight into the sharing-operation allocation calculations.
steps.title: Adjust the energy values

steps.text: Edit the description, the sampling power and the amperage. These updated figures feed straight into the sharing-operation allocation calculations.
steps.title: Adjust the energy values

steps.text: In the "Network operator" field, select the distribution grid operator the meter is connected to. This field is mandatory to validate the new configuration.
steps.title: Pick the network operator

steps.text: Switch the rate to "bi-hourly" and the client type to "professional" to mirror the meter's new consumption profile.
steps.title: Change the consumption profile

steps.text: Pick the date from which the new configuration takes effect. This field is required to validate the change.
steps.title: Set the effective date

steps.text: Click "Validate" — the form is sent to the CRM, which replaces the meter's current configuration. The dialog closes once the change is acknowledged.
steps.title: Save the update

steps.text: Back on the detail page, the new description, the 63 A amperage and the bi-hourly rate appear in the data cards — the changes have been persisted server-side.
steps.title: Update confirmed
